text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen without Maruzensky had 
finally arrived.

All she showed was a single moment of 
wavering. After that, Grass Wonder 
continued her rigorous training strictly 
"as usual," but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now then~. Everything's ready, so it's 
about time...

"...Looking closely at her feet as she 
said that, she was wearing training 
shoes."
choice_data_list: Are you sure you have the right shoes?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I-I am so sorry. I will go change my shoes 
immediately.

Having lost sight of her goal and where 
she should be heading, Grass Wonder's 
steps seemed somewhat clumsy.

Yet—even so, the cheers rise, and the 
gates of Arima fly open...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Good work today, Sei-chan~. How are you 
feeling?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So-so, I guess~? Well, pretty much the 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. In other words, things are going 
swimmingly~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well then, see ya at the race~.
